answer: Bind each identity to one hardware enclave that generates its key internally, never exports it, and refuses to hold a second identity. To answer, the enclave signs the epoch beacon inside the device, and remote attestation proves the signature came from genuine, unmodified hardware. A zephyr of cheap accounts dies here: one device cannot be cloned into fifty masks, so every extra identity costs a real device bought, powered, and kept online, and emulators fail attestation or repeat serials, lighting a lantern on the farm. Sybil scale stops being software and becomes a warehouse bill.
